categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in semiconductor equipment and system integration, key components manufacturing, and other related fields. It also engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of advanced equipment for semiconductor, flat panel display, nanotechnology, LED lighting, medical devices, and automation industries. Additionally, it conducts import and export trade related to its core business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced semiconductor process equipment technologies including micro-contamination control, EUV photomask automation, wafer sorting, and inspection systems. It employs precision manufacturing, vertical integration of surface treatment technologies, and system integration for automation equipment. The production process involves product development, parts manufacturing, subsystem integration, system assembly, and final testing and calibration, emphasizing high precision and contamination control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global semiconductor manufacturers and wafer fabs, including leading foundries and packaging/testing companies. The end markets served include semiconductor manufacturing, flat panel display, photonics, renewable energy, factory automation, and medical care industries. The company maintains strategic alliances with top-tier semiconductor equipment firms and supplies customized, high-precision equipment to these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and service facilities in Taiwan, China (Shanghai, Kunshan, Nanjing), the United States, Thailand, Singapore, and India. Its sales are predominantly in the Americas (approximately 87%), followed by Asia (about 6%), with minor sales in Europe and domestic Taiwan markets. It is expanding overseas production bases to enhance competitiveness and mitigate geopolitical risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in the manufacturing of advanced semiconductor process equipment and automation systems. It supplies critical subsystems and integrated equipment to wafer fabs and semiconductor manufacturers, supporting front-end wafer processing and back-end packaging/testing stages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes deepening core technology development, continuous innovation, and expanding into low-carbon, energy-saving intelligent equipment and smart manufacturing. R&D focuses on next-generation nanoprocess equipment, micro-contamination prevention, EUV photomask automation, wafer sorting and inspection automation, and medical precision equipment. It also invests in sustainability initiatives such as carbon emission monitoring and green manufacturing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized semiconductor and automation equipment, key components, and system integration services. The company also earns income from strategic investments and subsidiaries. Its business model relies on long-term contracts with major semiconductor manufacturers and continuous product development to meet evolving customer needs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other semiconductor equipment manufacturers, including domestic and international firms specializing in front-end process equipment and automation solutions. It holds a leading position in Taiwan’s semiconductor equipment sector, recognized as a top supplier by the world’s largest semiconductor equipment manufacturer. Its strategic alliances and high-quality, customized solutions create significant entry barriers for competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$16.45 billion in 2024, a 26% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to owners of NT$2.61 billion. Total assets reached NT$23.13 billion, and equity grew by 31%. The company has shown consistent growth driven by strong semiconductor market demand and expanding production capacity, including new facilities in Thailand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through high-precision, stable semiconductor process equipment tailored to advanced manufacturing nodes (down to 2nm). It offers comprehensive micro-contamination control solutions and integrates automation technologies to enhance production yield and efficiency. Its vertical integration capabilities, strategic partnerships with global leaders, and commitment to sustainability and innovation provide customers with reliable, cutting-edge equipment and responsive service.
